lines.en: I swing my tail and move slowly forward.
I swim along the marsh bottom.
I pass close to the weed.
I lay my long dorsal fin flat.
I head for the murky water.
I turn a slow bend.
I ripple backward with my body.
I work my way up the channel.
I slip under a fallen log.

lines.zh: 我朝浮着草叶的水面上去。
lines.en: I rise toward the floating leaves.
I swim in easy pulses.
I patrol along the bank.

lines.zh: 我把身子斜过来，过浅处。
lines.en: I slant my body through the shallows.
I sink back to the bottom.
I circle a reed.

lines.zh: 我朝有虫子落水的地方去。
lines.en: I head for where the insects fell in.
I ease behind the weed.
I swim toward the deeper ditch.
I hover, fins barely fanning.

lines.zh: 我斜着身子悬在倒木下。
lines.en: I hang at a slant beneath the sunken log.
I part my mouth slightly.
The murk hides me.

lines.zh: 我对着水面发了一会儿呆。
lines.en: I stare at the surface a while.
Something is skimming the surface.
I turn my body slowly.
I pin the weed with my tail.
I settle onto the mud.

lines.zh: 我把长鳍立起来，又放下。
lines.en: I raise my long fin and lower it.

lines.zh: 水里有很多小东西在动。
lines.en: Many small things move in the water.
I hover with nothing to do.
I release a string of bubbles slowly.
I float a little higher.

lines.zh: 我在水里对着你的方向。
lines.en: I face your way from the water.

lines.zh: 你站在岸上，影子压下来。
lines.en: You stand on the bank and your shadow falls.
I rise slowly into the shallows.
I study your hands.
When you move, I sink.

lines.zh: 我又浮上来，看你还在不在。
lines.en: I rise again to see if you are still there.
I watch you from just under the surface.
You do not come in, so I stay.
I fall back to the weed's edge.
I turn and go elsewhere.
I thrash my tail and bolt.
That landed on my flank.
I sink to the mud and stay still.
The water is churned thick.
The long fin on my back got sliced.
I come back to myself bit by bit.
I hide beneath the weed.
My tail can still swing.
I release a few bubbles.
I keep that in my fin rays.
Something has fallen into the water.
I float up a little at a time.
I swim toward that movement.
I sniff before opening my mouth.
That mouthful really is small.
I have swallowed it down.
I rise to check for more.
The insects on the surface are best.
That bite caught nothing.
I circle near that patch of water.
One knock and my flank tips.
I steady with my tail.
Bottom mud is stirred up.
I hide in the weed.
I back into deeper water.
That bump leaves my fins awry.
I slide by your leg.
I swing slowly back into place.
I cannot see in the murk.
I sink and stay still.
We swim side by side.
It circles me once.
We press together and sway slowly.
I chase it a stretch.
We circle the weed.
It goes and the water stills.
I turn my body aside.
We settle onto the mud together.
Our shadows overlap in the water.
We drift apart by degrees.
I open my mouth and gulp it down.
I hold it and chew slowly.
It was too hard, so I spat it out.
I draw it in with my lips.
It slipped out of my mouth.
I taste it; not bad.
I rise to look for more.
This one has a shell.
I press it against the weed.
Two mouthfuls and I am done.
Something moved on the surface.
I angle over to that side.
I fix on those ripples.
I lay my dorsal fin down.
I move in a very little.
It is on my stretch of water.
I raise my mouth to the surface.
I am long since ready.
It has not noticed me.
I wait for it to move once more.
I follow the ripples.
When it moves, I change my angle.
I stay beneath it.
I wait for it to come to the bank.
It holds and I hold.
I lower my dorsal fin.
The light on the surface shifts.
It is well away from the weed now.
I line my mouth up.
One more and I am there.
I bite it and drag it down.
I lash my tail once.
I ram its flank.
That bite held.
It struggles and I let go.
I bite a second time.
I drag it into the weed.
The water churns to mud.
It retreats and I sink.
The taste is still in my mouth.
I appear out of the murky water.
The water is slow here.
I swim one circle by the weed.
First I straighten my body.
There are fallen leaves on the bottom.
I shelter under a fallen log.
I float a little into the shallows.
There are many insects on the surface.
I sway slowly along the bank.
I settle back onto the mud.
The water warms and I dive deep.
I land on the mud and roll over.
There is not enough air and I thrash.

lines.zh: 炸响把水掀起来，我翻了。
lines.en: The blast lifts the water and rolls me.
Something passes through my fin.
Cold force coils around me in the water.
No food in the water and I am spent.

lines.zh: 雷随水传遍我整条身子。
lines.en: Lightning rides the water through my whole body.

lines.zh: 没有水也没有底，我一直落。
lines.en: No water and no bottom, and I fall on.
